summary: Hardcoded WebLogic admin password 'weblogic1' in ear/pom.xml <weblogic.local.password> property (legacy source, auto-deploy profile). Should be removed or moved to CI env vars before any deployment pipeline reuse.

Log4j 1.x (log4j:1.2.17 + slf4j-log4j12:1.7.21) present in legacy EAR module with scope=provided. Log4j 1.x reached EOL in 2015 and has multiple unpatched CVEs (CVE-2019-17571, deserialization RCE). Not carried forward into the Spring Boot kitchensink module, but the legacy pom should be noted.

No auth downgrade. Original app had no application-level security constraints (web.xml contained no security-constraint elements, no @RolesAllowed). Spring Boot migration correctly omits Spring Security — consistent with source baseline, not a downgrade.
H2 datasource uses username=sa with empty password. Acceptable for in-memory dev/test DB; would need replacement with real credentials before any production deployment target.

config/WebConfig.java cited in target-architecture.md §1 layout does not exist
detail: Target §1 lists kitchensink/src/main/java/com/example/kitchensink/config/WebConfig.java (context path config) as a required file. The file is absent; no config/ package exists at all.

summary: web/primary/MemberController.java (Thymeleaf UI controller) not present
detail: Target §1 and §6 cite web/primary/MemberController.java as the Thymeleaf @Controller replacing JSF MemberController. The file is absent; the UI layer for the primary context path (/web) is not implemented.

summary: web/secondary/MemberControllerSecond.java (Thymeleaf UI + @Value injection) not present
detail: Target §1, §6, and §7 cite web/secondary/MemberControllerSecond.java. It must use @Value("${config.key:Default value}") to replace DeltaSpike ConfigResolver. The file is absent; config.key is declared in application.properties but never consumed.

summary: data/MemberListProducer.java present; target §4 says 'Eliminate the producer bean'
detail: Target §4 explicitly says MemberListProducer should be eliminated because JSF EL is gone and controllers call the service directly. The data/ package is not in the target layout (§1). The file exists as a Spring @Component + @EventListener, which was not the intended migration path.

summary: H2 datasource URL in main application.properties but H2 has <scope>test</scope> in pom.xml
detail: application.properties sets spring.datasource.url=jdbc:h2:mem:kitchensink and spring.datasource.driver-class-name=org.h2.Driver, but H2 is declared <scope>test</scope>. The packaged fat jar will not contain H2 and will fail to boot. The datasource config must either reference a runtime-available DB or H2 scope must be changed to runtime/compile.

summary: No @DataJpaTest for MemberRepository — required by target §14 minimum acceptance test suite
detail: Target §14 lists @DataJpaTest covering MemberRepository (all 3 queries + edge cases) as part of the minimum acceptance test suite. No such test class exists in kitchensink/src/test/. Only @SpringBootTest (service) and @WebMvcTest (REST) tests are present.

summary: Loop-2 delta check: no new hardcoded secrets. MemberControllerSecond uses @Value('${config.key:Default value}') — properly externalized. No credentials in new Java or template files.
Loop-2 new dependencies clean: gson:2.10.1 (no known CVEs) and commons-io:2.16.1 (no known CVEs). Spring Boot 3.4.5 BOM unchanged.
Thymeleaf templates contain no th:utext (unescaped output). All user-facing data rendered via escaped th:text — no XSS risk introduced.
